data.message: I found Diana’s body in medbay and reported immediately. My route this round was weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay. I didn’t see anyone on the way and hadn’t encountered anyone before finding her. Body was right in medbay near the center/bottom area. Need everyone’s routes.

I started in medbay and then went to electrical. I saw Diana enter medbay from storage around tick 3, and Bob came into medbay from cafeteria around tick 4. I then went to electrical, and Bob was with me there until he left toward security at tick 7. I didn’t see the body myself.

Since Alice found Diana in medbay, the timing matters: Diana was alive in medbay when I saw her, and Bob was definitely also in/near medbay shortly after. Bob needs to explain his route after medbay and electrical.

I went upper engine -> oxygen -> cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical. In medbay I did see Diana there briefly, but she was upright/alive when I came through, so I didn’t report anything because there wasn’t a body on my screen. I left pretty quickly to electrical, and Frank saw me there right before the report.

So from my POV, the kill had to happen after I left medbay or right around that timing. Alice finding it after coming from cafeteria is worth noting, but I’m not hard accusing yet. I’d like Charlie and Eve’s routes because if they were near medbay/storage/cafeteria that matters a lot.

I was lower_engine -> storage this round. I didn’t go into medbay and I didn’t see Diana or anyone else before the report.

From what’s been said, the key window is medbay after Frank saw Diana there and after Bob passed through. Frank and Bob seem to confirm each other in electrical afterward, but Bob was definitely one of the last people seen with Diana in medbay. Alice is the reporter coming from cafeteria, so self-report is possible but I don’t have evidence for that.

I’d like to hear Eve’s route before deciding. If Eve was nowhere near medbay, then this is probably between Bob and Alice timing-wise.

I was navigation -> storage. I did not go medbay at all, and I never saw Diana. At the report I was in storage, and Charlie was there too, so I can at least confirm Charlie was in storage right then.

Based on everyone’s routes, Frank is probably less likely because Bob saw him in electrical after Diana was alive. Bob was one of the last seen with Diana in medbay, but Frank says Bob was in electrical with him after, so timing is tight unless Bob killed immediately before leaving. Alice is the reporter coming from cafeteria into medbay, so self-report is possible too.

I think this is mainly between Bob and Alice from the info we have. I’m not 100% sure, but Bob had direct confirmed contact with Diana in medbay, so I’m leaning Bob unless someone has stronger timing.

Reiterating: I came weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay, found Diana dead in medbay near center/bottom, and reported immediately. I did not see Bob, Frank, or anyone else in cafeteria/medbay when I arrived.

Given the routes, Charlie and Eve seem paired in storage at report time, and Frank/Bob place each other in electrical after Bob was in medbay. The important thing is Bob admits he was in medbay with Diana alive, and Frank also saw Bob enter medbay after Diana. I’m not saying impossible for someone else, but Bob had the clearest direct opportunity before the body was found.

Self-report accusation is possible, sure, but I literally walked in and reported with no one else around. My vote lean is Bob based on timing/contact with Diana.

I’ll clarify my timing: I was in medbay first, Diana came in from storage around tick 3, then Bob came in from cafeteria around tick 4 while Diana was still alive. I left to electrical after that, and Bob was with me in electrical until he left toward security right before the report.

So Bob could only be the killer if he killed Diana in that short window after I left medbay and before he joined me in electrical. Alice could be self-reporting, but I don’t have anything placing her with Diana before the report besides finding the body.

Charlie and Eve confirming each other in storage makes them less likely for this specific medbay kill. For me this is between Bob and Alice, and I’m leaning Bob because he was directly seen entering medbay with Diana alive, but I’m not 100% certain.

Frank’s timing is exactly why I don’t think this should land on me. I passed through medbay, saw Diana alive, then went straight electrical where Frank saw me. For me to be the killer, I’d have had to kill instantly in that tiny window and then immediately be with Frank in electrical right after — possible in theory, but that’s a very tight assumption.

Alice is the only person here with no one backing her route, and she’s the one who “found” the body coming from cafeteria into medbay. I’m not saying it’s 100% Alice, but between “Bob was seen after in electrical” and “Alice alone reports the body,” I don’t like how fast this is being pushed onto me.

Charlie/Eve being together in storage at report makes them less likely, Frank was with me in electrical, so if we’re voting between me and Alice, I think Alice is more suspicious here. At minimum, don’t vote me off on a timing guess.

My route was lower_engine -> storage. I never went into medbay and I didn’t see Diana at all. I was in storage at report time; Eve says she saw me there, so that lines up with her route, but I don’t have any direct info on the body.

Looking at the stories: Frank and Bob are backing each other for electrical after Bob left medbay, which makes Bob’s kill window really narrow — possible, but it would have to be a very quick kill before joining Frank. Alice is unvouched and is the reporter coming from cafeteria into medbay, so self-report is also possible.

I don’t think this is strong enough to confidently vote Bob just because he passed through medbay. For me it’s between Bob and Alice, but I’m leaning slightly more Alice based on lack of alibi and the tight timing on Bob. If people aren’t confident, skip is safer than forcing a bad vote.

My route was navigation -> storage. I didn’t go medbay and I didn’t see Diana alive or dead. At the report I was in storage; Charlie was there too, so that makes Charlie unlikely for this medbay kill.

From the discussion, I agree it’s mostly Bob vs Alice. Bob was directly seen in medbay with Diana alive, but Frank also says Bob was with him in electrical right after, so the kill window is narrow but possible. Alice is unvouched and reported the body, so self-report is possible too.

I’m slightly more suspicious of Bob because he’s the last confirmed person with Diana in medbay, but I’m not fully confident. If people are split, skip is safer than risking a wrong vote.
